source_title: n8n 2.17: New Moonshot Kimi and Alibaba Model Studio nodes, plus 5 other features
claim_summary: Release notes list Moonshot Kimi and Alibaba Model Studio (Qwen) nodes, MCP tool names prefixed with server name and blocking of manual role changes when SSO or expression mapping controls roles
feature: model-provider integrations; MCP tool naming; SSO role governance
availability: GitHub release n8n@2.17.0 is flagged prerelease (beta channel); stable promotion date not captured
limitation: Release notes are vendor statements; no independent exercise of nodes or role controls

product: n8n self-hosted and Cloud (1.x and 2.x lines)
source_title: n8n has Prototype Pollution in XML Webhook Body Parser that Leads to RCE (CVE-2026-42231)
claim_summary: Critical advisory: xml2js prototype pollution in XML webhook body parsing chained with Git node SSH operations for host RCE; patched in 1.123.32, 2.17.4 and 2.18.1; one of 12 n8n advisories published the same day (2 critical, 4 high, 6 medium) incl. Python task-runner sandbox escape and MCP OAuth XSS/DoS
feature: webhook parsing; expression/sandbox security; MCP OAuth
availability: patched versions published; workaround is restricting workflow editors to trusted users
limitation: Advisory text requires an authenticated workflow editor while the CVSS 4.0 vector lists PR:N; no exploitation prevalence data; advisory count is not a defect-rate denominator

product: n8n company / SAP Joule Studio partnership
source_title: n8n valuation doubles to $5.2bn as SAP makes strategic investment and plans to embed the AI platform into Joule Studio
source_publisher: Highland Europe (investor reprint of n8n/SAP joint press release)
claim_summary: Joint release (Orlando/Berlin) states SAP strategic investment valuing n8n at USD 5.2bn, a multi-year commercial partnership and that n8n will be embedded natively within SAP Joule Studio; claims 1400+ enterprise customers, 1.7mn monthly active builders and 1000+ integrations
availability: Joule Studio embedding stated as future (will be); no launch date; investment amount undisclosed
limitation: Valuation, customer and community figures are company claims, not verified adoption; Tech.eu coverage adds no independent verification

source_title: n8n 2.21: Webhook signature verification added across trigger nodes, plus 23 other features
claim_summary: Release notes state many trigger nodes now verify incoming webhook signatures, Jira node gains OAuth2 (3LO) and the evaluation run detail page is redesigned
availability: released minor; per-node coverage not enumerated here
limitation: Coverage of each trigger node not independently checked; a Sep 2 advisory (GHSA-5m98-cgcr-xx3q) later reports a GitHub Trigger path where signature verification failed open

product: n8n HTTP Request, XML and Git nodes
source_title: HTTP Request Node Pagination Prototype Pollution to RCE (CVE-2026-44789)
claim_summary: Critical advisory: authenticated workflow editor could pollute global prototype via HTTP Request pagination parameter leading to RCE; fixed in 1.123.43, 2.20.7, 2.22.1; same-day batch of 7 includes critical XML Node patch bypass of the April fix (GHSA-wrwr-h859-xh2r) and Git node arbitrary file read
availability: patched versions published; NODES_EXCLUDE workaround
limitation: A patch bypass of an April fix within three weeks indicates incomplete remediation, not measured exploitation; no independent reproduction here

source_title: n8n MCP Browser HTTP Transport Exposes Unauthenticated Browser-Control Sessions (CVE-2026-54309)
claim_summary: High advisory: @n8n/mcp-browser in HTTP transport accepted unauthenticated MCP sessions able to drive the user's real browser profile via the AI Browser Bridge extension; default stdio transport unaffected; fixed 2.25.7 and 2.26.2; one of 18 advisories that day
feature: MCP browser control; agent tool authentication
availability: patched; only non-default HTTP transport affected
limitation: Configuration-specific; no exploitation evidence; advisory count reflects disclosure batching not defect rate

source_title: n8n 2.27: Create variables and data tables from add menu, plus 17 other features
claim_summary: Release notes list MCP Server Trigger support for n8n OAuth2 authentication, creation of variables and data tables from the global add menu and a Kafka Schema Registry credential
availability: released minor
limitation: Vendor description only; MCP OAuth interoperability with third-party clients not tested

source_title: n8n 2.28: GitHub node adds pull request resource, plus 27 other features
claim_summary: Release notes state GitHub node gains a Pull Request resource (create, update, merge, diffs), Instance AI opens from the editor and can investigate failed executions, and many Microsoft/Google nodes accept generic OAuth2 or custom scopes
feature: GitHub PR automation; AI-assisted failure investigation
availability: released minor; Instance AI scope/plan limits not stated in the note
limitation: Agent-driven PR merge capability raises review/permission questions; no independent task test

source_title: Allowed HTTP Request Domains Restriction Bypass via AI Agents MCP Connector (CVE-2026-59207)
claim_summary: High advisory: AI Agents feature did not enforce credential domain restrictions, letting a member with use-only access send a shared credential secret to an attacker URL via an MCP tool; affects instances with N8N_ENABLED_MODULES=agents; fixed 2.27.4 and 2.28.1
availability: patched; module-gated
limitation: Shows agent tool paths bypassing existing credential guards; no prevalence data

source_title: You can now use OpenTelemetry with n8n: Production Tracing for Workflows
claim_summary: Staff post announces OpenTelemetry workflow and node-level tracing requiring n8n 2.22.0+; available on all plans including free self-hosted community edition; custom telemetry tags enterprise-only
availability: all plans per post; beta/GA status not stated
limitation: Forum post is vendor statement; OTel export overhead and completeness not measured

source_title: Announcing Canvas Groups! Expand and collapse node groups
claim_summary: Staff post: collapse related nodes into a named block on the canvas from n8n 2.28.3, Cloud and self-hosted; described as an early release; staff reply says it is behind a feature flag disabled when telemetry is off
availability: early release behind feature flag; no trigger nodes or sticky notes in groups at publication
limitation: Visual grouping is not reusable sub-workflow packaging; 2.32 notes later add sticky notes/descriptions

product: n8n expression engine, Git node, Resource Locator
source_title: Legacy Expression Evaluator Sanitizer Bypass Leads to Authenticated Code Execution
claim_summary: High advisory: legacy expression evaluator (default engine in affected versions) sanitizer bypass gives workflow editors host code execution; fixed 1.123.64, 2.29.8, 2.30.1; workaround N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE=vm; same-day batch of 14 includes Git clone TOCTOU RCE (GHSA-g3r5-9h93-4j2c) and Resource Locator stored DOM XSS
feature: expression sandbox; Git node; UI XSS
availability: patched
limitation: GHSA shows no CVE for this item while CERT.UG (row 044-015) cites CVE-2026-65591 and a Jul 22 disclosure date; identifiers/dates unreconciled

source_title: Introducing the AI Assistant: the workflow-building agent inside n8n!
claim_summary: Staff post introduces a chat agent that plans, builds, tests and troubleshoots workflows, asks confirmation before publish/delete, keeps credentials out of the model and replaces the AI Workflow Builder; Preview on Cloud from 2.29.9; self-hosted manual pre-release; not on Enterprise plans; credit-metered
availability: Preview; Cloud first; not Enterprise
limitation: No independent task-success or safety evaluation; credit pricing changes later (row 044-022)

source_title: n8n 2.32: Scope selection for MCP OAuth consent, plus 12 other features
claim_summary: Release notes state MCP OAuth consent lets users choose All, Read only or Custom scopes and shows how many MCP tools each scope unlocks; canvas groups gain descriptions and sticky-note support
availability: released minor
limitation: Scope enforcement later shown incomplete in Sep 3 advisory GHSA-cw9w-vv67-hf73 (refresh-token resource substitution)

product: n8n (expression evaluator, Git node, Resource Locator)
source_title: n8n Workflow Automation Platform Triple Vulnerability Chain Enables Server Takeover (CVE-2026-65591 / CVE-2026-65592 / CVE-2026-65598)
claim_summary: National CERT reports three chainable flaws letting a user with workflow-creation rights reach server code execution and hijack sessions of users opening a shared workflow; fixed in 1.123.64, 2.29.8, 2.30.1; recommends restricting editors and auditing workflow JSON for javascript: prefixes
availability: patched versions per CERT
limitation: Independent of vendor but derivative of vendor disclosure; CVE IDs and stated Jul 22 disclosure differ from GHSA records published Jul 8; no exploitation evidence

source_title: RCE in the n8n Main Process via Path Traversal in MCP Node-Schema Loading
claim_summary: High advisory: node-schema loader derived module path from attacker-supplied node type allowing a global:member user code execution in the main process; workaround disable instance-level MCP; fixed 2.33.4 and 2.34.1; one of 17 advisories that day
availability: patched
limitation: Agent/MCP surface expands attack surface; not measured prevalence

source_title: Malicious code in @years20/n8n-nodes-utils-helper-j (npm)
claim_summary: OSV record flags an npm package named like an n8n community node as malicious (finder Amazon Inspector); part of a reported batch of similarly named packages
availability: record only; install counts and victims unknown
limitation: Not an n8n product defect; single record verified, wider batch only seen in search snippets; January 2026 campaign is out of window

source_title: n8n 2.37: Streaming responses for Message an Agent, plus 15 other features
claim_summary: Release notes deprecate the Any workflow sub-workflow caller policy ahead of removal in n8n v3 because it bypasses project permissions; dropdown now warns; Message an Agent supports opt-in streaming
availability: deprecation label shipped; removal planned for v3 with no date
limitation: Removal timing for v3 not stated; caller-policy enforcement gap on agent tool path disclosed Sep 2 (row 044-019)

source_title: Agent Workflow Tool Bypasses Sub-Workflow Caller Policy (CVE-2026-86996)
claim_summary: Medium advisory: sub-workflow caller policy enforced by Execute Workflow node was not consulted when the same workflow was attached to an Agent as a tool; fixed 2.37.7 and 2.38.2; one of 19 advisories published Sep 2-3
availability: patched
limitation: Illustrates that reuse via agent tools needs the same permission checks as direct reuse; no exploitation data

source_title: Assistant update: agents, MCP servers, one-line self-hosting, and more
claim_summary: Staff post renames AI Assistant to n8n Assistant; adds agent building (rolling out), MCP servers from a registry, data-table editing, web research, Gateway credits (Cloud), and one-line Docker self-hosting from n8n 2.35
feature: assistant agents; MCP registry; self-host install
availability: still preview; Cloud Starter/Pro default; self-hosted Docker only; Enterprise on roadmap
limitation: Rolling availability; one-line install claim not independently timed

source_title: Community Package Install Validation Bypass via PubSub in Queue Mode Deployments
claim_summary: High advisory: in Redis queue mode the internal install handler skipped name/prefix validation, permission check, checksum and npm safety check, so anyone able to write to Redis could install any npm package on every instance; fixed 1.123.80, 2.39.6, 2.40.1; one of 16 that day
availability: patched; workaround N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED=false
limitation: Requires Redis write access; no exploitation data

source_title: Try new models and services, skip the account setup
claim_summary: Blog states Gateway credits (n8n v2.36+) let users call six model providers and five tool services from a prepaid n8n balance without own API keys; Cloud Starter and Pro only; self-hosted intended over time
availability: shipped on Cloud Starter/Pro; self-hosted only intended
limitation: Self-hosted parity is an intention; forum topic of the same title created 2026-09-02 precedes the Sep 17 blog date; vendor intermediation adds pricing/data-flow dependence not assessed

source_title: Introducing n8n Agents
claim_summary: Blog introduces goal-driven agents configured with model, instructions, MCP servers, nodes and workflows as scoped tools, approvals, draft/published versions and session logs, plus a Message an Agent node; each agent turn counts as one execution
feature: agent runtime with workflows as tools
availability: still in preview; Cloud all users; self-hosted Community with extra setup; Enterprise preview
limitation: Vendor claims not independently tested; forum topic of the same title was created 2026-08-05 per forum JSON, earlier than the Sep 25 blog date, so first-announcement date is unresolved; several Sep 30 advisories concern agent tool/approval paths

source_title: Shared Prototype Mutation Through the MCP Workflow-Validation Interpreter Allows Owner Account Takeover
claim_summary: High advisory: MCP workflow-validation tool evaluated caller code in the main process; a read-only member could defeat a permission check and take over the instance owner account (MFA accounts unaffected); fixed 2.41.4 and 2.42.1; one of 14 that day incl. Send-and-Wait HMAC approval bypass
feature: MCP server isolation; human approval integrity
availability: patched; workaround disable instance-level MCP and enforce MFA
limitation: No exploitation data; batch includes approval-gate bypasses relevant to agent HITL claims

source_title: n8n 2.43: Browser Use now available to all users, plus 13 other features
claim_summary: Release notes state Browser Use in the n8n Assistant is available to all users, controlled by N8N_INSTANCE_AI_BROWSER_USE_ENABLED (on by default) rather than an experiment; experimental automatic credential setup disabled by default
availability: GitHub n8n@2.43.0 flagged prerelease; Chrome/Chromium only; not on phones/tablets
limitation: Default-on browser control widens attack surface (cf. June MCP browser advisory); Cloud vs self-hosted scope not stated

claim_summary: GitHub release shows the 1.123.x legacy line still receiving patch releases on 2026-10-08, ten months after 2.0; in-window advisories list 1.123.x fixed versions alongside 2.x
availability: released patch
limitation: Official 1.x end-of-support date not found; third-party claims of a March 2026 end are contradicted by these releases
